step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture shows an operational MongoDB database sending change streams to Kinesis Data Firehose, which buffers and stores raw data in an S3 Raw Zone bucket. AIS middleware also feeds external accounting data directly to the S3 Raw Zone. AWS Glue crawls and cleans/deduplicates the raw data into an S3 Landing Zone bucket. Glue transforms the landing zone data into a star schema loaded into Amazon Aurora. Amazon Athena queries the curated data in S3. Users interact via a CDN (CloudFront) pointing to an Elastic Beanstalk backend, which queries Amazon Aurora.
